The story follows the adventures of Jade, an investigative reporter, martial artist, and spy working with a resistance movement to reveal a sinister alien conspiracy. Players control Jade and other allies, solving puzzles, fighting enemies, obtaining photographic evidence and, later in the game, travelling to space. Michel Ancel, creator of the Rayman series, envisioned the game as the first part of a trilogy.

Amiga:humans.d: The Humans is a 1992 puzzle-platform game developed by Imagitec Design and published by Mirage Technologies for the Amiga. It was ported to other home computers and consoles.
